vopros: What do you know about Vita Kamliuk, a real estate agent in Los Angeles? Which brokerage is she with?

vyzhimka.tekst:
Vita Kamliuk is a licensed Los Angeles real estate agent. She is currently affiliated with Compass. Her California license is DRE #02166055, and Compass lists her on its official agent directory. ([compass.com](https://www.compass.com/agents/vita-kamliuk/?utm_source=openai))

A few details about her background and practice:

- She works in residential real estate across Greater Los Angeles, with particular emphasis on the San Fernando Valley and Westside, including Sherman Oaks, Valley Village, Studio City, Tarzana, Westwood, Beverly Hills, and West Hollywood. ([askvita.com](https://askvita.com/?utm_source=openai))
- Compass lists her specialties as buyer representation, listings, relocation, and property management. She speaks English and Russian. ([compass.com](https://www.compass.com/agents/vita-kamliuk/?utm_source=openai))
- Before her Los Angeles residential career, she worked in commercial real estate, including positions with Knight Frank and Colliers International. Her own biography says she has roughly 18 years of industry experience and has participated in more than 500 transactions. ([askvita.com](https://askvita.com/?utm_source=openai))
- She previously worked at Keller Williams Beverly Hills; a 2022 VoyageLA profile identifies her with that brokerage. She has since moved to Compass. ([voyagela.com](https://voyagela.com/interview/exploring-life-business-with-vita-kamliuk-of-keller-williams/?utm_source=openai))
- Recent activity from August/September 2026 also identifies her as “Vita Kamliuk | Compass,” corroborating that the Compass affiliation is current rather than an outdated profile. ([linkedin.com](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/vita-kamliuk-3a53614b_beverly-hills-luxury-la-real-estate-weekly-activity-7495239590556078080-L1q9?utm_source=openai))

So, as of September 2026: Vita Kamliuk → Compass, DRE #02166055.

If you're considering working with her, I can also look into her recent sales/listings, transaction history, client reviews, and licensing/disciplinary record to give you a more independent picture of her track record.
